usecase.name: [QA Validation App] UJ-15 Application Dataset Repeat Execution
usecase.description: Create a dataset on the application's Datasets page, add a Repeat step on a new use case with Dataset source 'Application dataset', add two steps inside, trigger an execution and verify the execution lists four steps tagged Row 1/2 and Row 2/2, then delete the use case and the dataset

steps.instruction: Focus the username field
Focus the password field
Click the 'Sign in' button
Click the 'Applications' menu item in the left navigation
Open the application 'QA Studio' (click its card if several applications are listed)
Is the application 'QA Studio' detail page shown?
Open the 'Actions' dropdown in the application page header
Select 'Datasets' under 'Configuration' in the dropdown
Is the page heading 'Datasets' shown?
Is the breadcrumb 'Applications > QA Studio > Datasets' shown?
Click the 'Create dataset' button
Is a dialog with the header 'Create dataset' shown?
Type '{{dataset_name}}' in the Name field of the dialog
Type 'Journey test dataset' in the Description field of the dialog
Clear the 'Column 1 name' field and type 'email'
Click the 'Column' button to add a column
Clear the 'Column 2 name' field and type 'role'
Type 'alice@example.com' in the 'Row 1, email' field
Type 'admin' in the 'Row 1, role' field
Click the 'Row' button to add a row
Type 'bob@example.com' in the 'Row 2, email' field
Type 'viewer' in the 'Row 2, role' field
Click the 'Create' button in the dialog
Is the dataset '{{dataset_name}}' listed in the Datasets table?
Does the row of dataset '{{dataset_name}}' show 2 in the Columns column?
Does the row of dataset '{{dataset_name}}' show 2 in the Rows column?
Click the 'Use cases' menu item in the left navigation
Click the 'Create Use case' button
Select the 'Create New' option
Click the 'Next' button
Select the 'Web' platform option
Click the 'Next' button
Type '{{usecase_name}}' in the Name field
Type 'https://example.com' in the Starting URL field
Select 'eu-central-1' in the Execution Region dropdown
Select 'nova-act-v1.0' in the Model dropdown
Select 'QA Studio' in the Application dropdown
Click the 'Next' button
Select the 'Create Blank' option
Click the 'Next' button
Click the 'Next' button
Click the 'Create' button
Click the 'Workflow Steps' tab
Click the 'Add Step' button
Type 'Repeat' in the 'Search step types...' field
Select the 'Repeat' option
Type 'Login as each user' in the Label field
Does the 'Dataset source' field offer the option 'Application dataset'?
Select the 'Application dataset' option under 'Dataset source'
Open the 'Application dataset' dropdown
Does the option '{{dataset_name}}' in the open dropdown show the description '2 columns × 2 rows'?
Select the option '{{dataset_name}}'
Click the 'Create Step' button
Does the Workflow Steps list show a step with the 'Repeat' badge?
Does the Repeat step show the summary 'Application dataset: {{dataset_name}} · 2 rows · 2 columns'?
Click the 'Add step inside' link on the Repeat step card
Does the dialog show the hint 'Inside: Login as each user'?
Type 'Type {{email}} into the email field' in the Instruction field
Click the 'Create Step' button
Click the 'Add step inside' link on the Repeat step card
Type 'Check that the role {{role}} is shown' in the Instruction field
Click the 'Create Step' button
Return the number of step cards indented under the Repeat step that are marked with '↳'
Two steps are indented under the Repeat step
Click the 'Trigger Execution' button
Click the 'Execution History' tab
Click the radio button of the most recent execution, the first row in the 'Execution History' table; a panel opens at the bottom of the page
Scroll down inside the panel at the bottom of the page to the table with the heading 'Execution Steps'
Return the number of rows in the 'Execution Steps' table that show a step number in the '#' column
The repeat was unrolled into 2 dataset rows x 2 steps
Does the 'Execution Steps' table show the badge 'Row 1/2'?
Does the 'Execution Steps' table show the badge 'Row 2/2'?
Does the 'Execution Steps' table show the row header 'Login as each user — row 1 of 2'?
Click the 'Use cases' menu item in the left navigation
Type '[QA Test] AppDataset {{UniqueID}}' in the search bar
Click the checkbox in front of use case '{{usecase_name}}'
Open the actions dropdown above the table
Select 'Delete Selected (1)' from the dropdown
Type 'permanently delete' in the confirmation field of the dialog
Click the 'Delete' button in the dialog
Is use case '{{usecase_name}}' listed in the table?
Click the 'Applications' menu item in the left navigation
Open the application 'QA Studio' (click its card if several applications are listed)
Is the application 'QA Studio' detail page shown?
Open the 'Actions' dropdown in the application page header
Select 'Datasets' under 'Configuration' in the dropdown
Is the page heading 'Datasets' shown?
Is the breadcrumb 'Applications > QA Studio > Datasets' shown?
Select the row of dataset '{{dataset_name}}' in the Datasets table
Click the 'Delete' button above the Datasets table
Is a dialog with the header 'Delete Dataset' shown?
Type 'permanently delete' in the confirmation field of the dialog
Click the 'Delete' button in the dialog
Is the dataset '{{dataset_name}}' listed in the Datasets table?
